In absolute terms, <citation-number id="query_59949b2e" column="multi_listings">12,135</citation-number> out of <citation-number id="query_59949b2e" column="total_listings">14,901</citation-number> total listings are owned by multi-listing hosts — meaning the market is heavily dominated by professional or semi-professional hosts rather than one-time renters.

args.sql_query:
WITH host_listing_counts AS (
    SELECT host_id, COUNT(*) AS listing_count
    FROM listings
    GROUP BY host_id
),
categorized AS (
    SELECT
        CASE WHEN listing_count >= 2 THEN 'multi' ELSE 'single' END AS host_type,
        listing_count
    FROM host_listing_counts
),
totals AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(listing_count) AS total_listings,
        SUM(CASE WHEN host_type = 'multi' THEN listing_count ELSE 0 END) AS multi_listings
    FROM categorized
)
SELECT
    total_listings,
    multi_listings,
    ROUND(100.0 * multi_listings / total_listings, 2) AS pct_multi_host_listings
FROM totals;
args.name: Multi-host listing percentage
